mechanical_role_crosswalk.stage_A_received_yuanshi: rate residual × 損益分 ÷ 820; result added/subtracted to base 遲疾度; 820 is DIVISOR in an interpolation route.
mechanical_role_crosswalk.stage_B_received_yuanshi: combined signed 盈縮差/遲疾差 × 820 ÷ current 遲疾限下行度 = 朔弦望 time adjustment; 820 is MULTIPLIER in a different stage.
mechanical_role_crosswalk.stage_B_ming_print_xing: 遲疾捷法 = 820 ÷ 遲行度; a source-original reciprocal coefficient that is consistent at the algebraic-dependency level with the received Yuan Shi time-adjustment multiplier.
mechanical_role_crosswalk.algebraic_dependency_only: If an edition-bound numerator E and a matching row rate R are established, then E × (820/R) = (E × 820)/R. This equality does NOT authenticate any value, stage-specific quantizer, radix or particular Xing/G893 lane.
mechanical_role_crosswalk.non_equivalence: The YuanShi source calls its denominator 所入遲疾限下行度 while Xing prints 遲行度. Similar operator structure alone cannot prove those table fields, units, precision, limit indexing or rounding stages are identical.
mechanical_role_crosswalk.distinct_xing_first_table: Xing's original first-table gloss divides accumulated degree difference by 日率 for 損益捷法; do not collapse it into either role of 820 merely because both appear in the same broad lunar family.

negative_boundaries: Two digital interfaces for YuanShi are not two independent original old-print witnesses.
Algebraic equivalence at the reciprocal-coefficient level is not proof of actual operand equality, printed-output agreement, source-to-source copying or direct Yuan-to-Ming lineage.
YuanShi received-text subtraction/division has not been authenticated on a Yuan-era original physical page; no original glyph grade upgrade.
No source-native micro radix, quantizer, carry instruction, raw lunar Ji/Chi speed identity or new G893 six final numbers are established.
Earlier 13TO same NLC/Wikimedia print original image remains the only original Xing authority used here; no new registered source or physical witness.

explicit_non_edges: Algebraically parallel reciprocal operations across received YuanShi and Ming Xing do not establish edition-stemma descent or G893 same-field speed values.
